content.short: COINS.FUN is a token launchpad on Stable where anyone can create and trade tokens paired with USDT0.
content.description: COINS.FUN is a launchpad on Stable chain for creating and trading tokens, with trading settled in USDT0. It shows live launches, volume and portfolios, and has indexed more than 100 launched tokens and millions of dollars in volume.
